for dir in /data/*/; do
  [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
  echo ">>> Pruning $dir"
  RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$dir" restic forget \
    --keep-hourly 24 \
    --keep-daily 5 \
    --keep-weekly 4 \
    --keep-monthly 3 \
    --prune \
    --verbose
done

[SERVICE]
  daemon off
  flush 5
  log_level warn
  parsers_file /fluent-bit/etc/parsers.conf
  http_server on
  http_listen 0.0.0.0
  http_port 2020

[INPUT]
  name syslog
  parser syslog-rfc3164
  tag syslog.*
  mode tcp
  listen 0.0.0.0
  port 5140

[INPUT]
  name syslog
  parser syslog-rfc3164
  tag syslog.*
  mode udp
  listen 0.0.0.0
  port 5140

[FILTER]
  name modify
  match syslog*
  rename message log
  add _stream syslog

[OUTPUT]
  name http
  match syslog*
  host victoria-logs.observability.svc.cluster.local
  port 9428
  uri /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=_stream,host,ident&_msg_field=log&_time_field=date
  format json_lines
  json_date_format iso8601
  compress gzip
  log_response_payload false
